about: Round 3 (10-19): the round 2 keepers folded into the two built-in looks with look-level settings (auto.js deeper(): texture depth x1.65 + fine relief x1.4 = A11/A15; side lamp x -0.05, y 0.4 = B02+B04). L = 'Favourite, side lamp left', F = 'Favourite, from the left', both as now built in. 02s are round 2's looks (controls). The rest combine the other keepers: brighter (A03), lift darks (A08, made with room light 0.4 + graze shadow lift 0.9, which match its shadow-to-mid ratio), raking light from lower left (B10), lower (B25), cool fill from the right (B27), 5000 K (maybe A13). exposureAdd skips the whites guard: watch the clip stats. Each job: look, addLights, exposureAdd, scale, set (tools/digilight-cli.cjs batch).
